scope: process-only restoration of historical K77 v0.83-v0.100 certificate transport

contract.historical_snapshot: each certificate keeps its exact named ledger and version-local scientific evidence immutable
contract.current_authority: the live research-evidence contract names one append-only standing ledger
contract.ancestry_proof: walk predecessor edges from the live standing ledger to each exact historical snapshot
superseded_checks_removed: historical ledger remains the live standing pointer
historical directive or successor remains active
historical exact repository inventory remains current

validation.restored_cohort_before: 0/15 green under mutable current-pointer and front-door expectations
validation.restored_cohort_after: 15/15 green under historical snapshot plus append-only ancestry

hostile_review.strongest_overclaim: append-only ancestry proves durable custody of each historical checkpoint, not that an old directive remains current or that any scientific grade increased
hostile_review.strongest_contrary_case: removing current-front-door assertions could erase version-local scientific evidence; every ledger, registry, report, source, review, computation, constraint and accounting assertion remains
hostile_review.weakest_reproducibility_seam: all 15 restored gates import one ancestry predicate, so the complete family and the predicate's four planted controls run together

reopen_only_on: a broken or missing predecessor edge
a historical target skipped by the live chain
a concrete version-local scientific, source, review, computation, constraint or accounting regression
